repo: https://github.com/Factory-AI/droid-action (the only public Factory repo; the droid CLI itself is closed-source — https://github.com/Factory-AI/droid returns 404)
surfaces: CLI interactive TUI (`droid`), headless (`droid exec`, `--output-format json|stream-json|acp|stream-jsonrpc`), VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf extension (marketplace itemName `Factory.factory-vscode-extension`, title "Droid - Factory's AI Coding Agent"), JetBrains AI Chat via ACP agent "Factory Droid" (`droid exec --output-format acp`), Zed Agent Panel via ACP, Factory desktop app. All of them share the same local session store under ~/.factory/sessions — the IDE surfaces are front-ends over the same CLI, not separate stores.
binaries: droid (Windows: droid.exe, npm package `droid` v0.245.0, Homebrew cask `droid`, standalone installer app.factory.ai/cli/windows; upstream release path https://downloads.factory.ai/factory-cli/releases/<version>/windows/x64/droid.exe)

paths: %USERPROFILE%\.factory\sessions\-C--Users-<user>-Documents-<Project>\<uuid>.jsonl   (per-project subdir = sanitized cwd, drive colon and separators replaced by '-', prefixed with '-')
%USERPROFILE%\.factory\sessions\<uuid>.jsonl   (legacy flat layout, still read by the CLI)
%USERPROFILE%\.factory\sessions\<uuid>.settings.json   (sidecar, same dir as the session file)
storage.format: JSONL — one JSON object per line, UTF-8, LF-terminated, plain text (NOT encrypted, NOT SQLite, NOT protobuf). Line 1 = session_start header; then message / agent_turn_outcome / todo_state / compaction_state records. Sidecar <uuid>.settings.json is a plain JSON object rewritten in place (model, reasoningEffort, providerLock, providerLockTimestamp, tokenUsage, tags, archivedAt).
storage.append_semantics: APPEND-ONLY and LIVE. The CLI creates the file once with writeFileSync(header + "\n") and then appends every record with fs.appendFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(record)+"\n") under a lock file <path>.events.lock (batched writer with byte thresholds; per-session monotonic `seq`). Verified in the upstream 0.245.0 Windows binary. No rewrite of the body; only the first line can be re-summarised (title update / `shouldRewriteSessionSummary`) and a fork writes a fresh file. -> Existing LogTailer works as-is; no watcher/main.rs surgery required.
storage.session_file_naming: Session id = file stem, a UUID (e.g. 0f7d6c2a-9a1b-4d3e-8c55-2f1c9a7b4e10.jsonl). Directory grouping: one directory per workspace, named from the cwd by a sanitizer: POSIX '/Users/me/proj' -> '-Users-me-proj'; Windows 'C:\Users\me\proj' -> '-C--Users-me-proj'. Project dirs are exactly the ones starting with '-'. Session id == settings sidecar stem.

fields.project: YES — session_start.cwd (absolute workspace path); only the final folder name may be published. Fallback: the project dir name (sanitized cwd).
fields.model: YES but NOT in the JSONL — it lives in the sibling <uuid>.settings.json (fields `model`, `reasoningEffort`, `providerLock`, `providerLockTimestamp`) or in ctx's read of `metadata.model`/`message.model` passthrough fields. Reading the sidecar opportunistically on session_start is required for a model label.
fields.file_basename: YES — tool_use.input.file_path (Read/Create/Edit/MultiEdit), and ApplyPatch patch markers '*** Update File:'; the edit tool result also carries files[].file_path + display_operation(create|update|delete).
fields.tool_activity: YES — tool_use.name is the canonical Droid tool id (Read, Create, Edit, MultiEdit, ApplyPatch, Glob, Grep, LS, Execute, Script, WaitForScript, TodoWrite, AskUser, Task, SpawnAgent, ListAgents, SendMessage, WebSearch, FetchUrl, GenerateImage, getIdeDiagnostics, ...) and tool_use.input.command for Execute.
fields.phase: YES — role/content block shape distinguishes thinking (thinking block or text-only assistant message) vs running tools (tool_use present); turn boundaries via agent_turn_outcome records.
fields.timestamps: YES — every record carries `timestamp` as an RFC3339 ISO-8601 string with milliseconds ("2026-10-20T09:30:12.000Z"); `seq` is an integer monotonic counter; `parentId` links a message to its predecessor.

parser_strategy:
Add `Provider::FactoryDroid` + `parse_factory_droid_line(line)` in events.rs, wired into parse_line_for.

Record dispatch (one JSONL line -> Vec<ParsedEvent>):
1) type=="session_start": if `cwd` present -> SessionMetadata{project: project_name(cwd), cwd}. Never read `title`/`owner`/`organizationId`. Also treat the header timestamp (or the first user message) as TaskStarted{started_at_ms} (RFC3339 -> ms via existing timestamp_ms). If the header carries `parent`/`callingSessionId` -> the session is a subagent session: emit SubagentSpawned{conversation_id: parent, agent: "Factory subagent"}.
2) type=="message": look at value["message"]["role"] and value["message"]["content"] (array of blocks; also accept top-level role/content as ctx's parser does).
   - role=="user" and content contains a "tool_result" block -> TrackedToolFinished{call_id: block["tool_use_id"] | block["toolUseId"]} (one event per block; ignore is_error text).
   - role=="assistant" and content contains a "tool_use" block -> TrackedToolStarted{call_id: block["id"], activity: ToolActivity{label: classify_tool(mapped_name, input.command), file: extract_file_basename(input), language: language_from_file(file)}}. mapped_name must translate Droid ids to Discodex vocabulary FIRST, because classify_tool() does not match them as-is: ApplyPatch -> "apply_patch" (classify_tool tests `contains("apply_patch")`, the raw id lowercases to "applypatch" and would MISS), Create -> "write", Edit/MultiEdit -> "edit", Read -> "read", LS -> "list", Grep -> "grep", Glob -> "glob", Execute/Script -> "exec" (pass input.command so cargo/npm/git heuristics work), TodoWrite -> "todo", Task/SpawnAgent/SendMessage -> "task", AskUser -> "ask", WebSearch -> "web_search", FetchUrl -> "fetch". File basename comes from input keys "file_path"/"filePath"/"path"/"file" and from input."patch" lines "*** Update File: x" (extract_file_basename already supports both).
   - role=="assistant" and content contains a "thinking" block -> Thinking{reasoning: None} (do NOT publish model reasoning text; Claude-Code-style heading extraction is optional but not required for richness).
   - role=="assistant" and text-only content -> TerminalCandidate (or Thinking).
   - role=="user" and text-only content -> TaskStarted{started_at_ms: record timestamp}.
3) type=="agent_turn_outcome" -> Completed (this is the turn/phase boundary; `reason` values beyond "error" are UNVERIFIED).
4) type=="todo_state" | "compaction_state" -> Thinking{reasoning: None} (or ignore).

Model: the JSONL has no model field. To publish a model label, on the session_start line read the sibling settings file <same dir>/<stem>.settings.json once (read-only, never tailed) and emit AgentDetected{agent: settings.model} sanitised to an id-like token (letters/digits/._-:@ only, <=128 chars) — mirror deepseek_model_label(). This needs one small addition in main.rs/state.rs (a sidecar read hook) or can be deferred; without it the adapter is still "rich minus model".

Dedup/fail-safe: cancelled+retried tool calls REUSE the message id (ctx issue #261), so dedupe records by (id, seq) and treat a repeated id as a new occurrence only if `parentId` differs. Make the session_start handler idempotent (don't reset the timer if the project is already set).
discodex_plan:
Provider variant + display name:
  Provider::FactoryDroid, display_name() = "Factory Droid", has_session_tracking() -> true, default_activity() = "Working with coding agent", from_executable("droid"|"droid.exe") -> Some(FactoryDroid). (Window-title matching is UNVERIFIED and unnecessary: droid runs inside a terminal whose host process is the terminal, so focus detection should rely on the session log, not the window title.)

SessionSource roots (add to session_sources()):
  home.join(".factory").join("sessions")                      // primary: %USERPROFILE%\.factory\sessions
  home.join(".factory").join("projects")                      // defensive: only if the dir exists (see risks)
Note the "btw" subdir is inside the primary root; Discodex's recent_logs() already walks it (side-question sessions will show up as their own session — acceptable, or skip a dir literally named "btw").

is_session_log rule (exact):
  FactoryDroid => file name ends with ".jsonl" (case-insensitive), does not end with ".settings.json" (auto-excluded), does not end with ".events.lock" (auto-excluded), and the stem is not a dotfile. Do NOT require a "rollout-"/"transcript" prefix and do NOT exclude the project dir (its name starts with '-', not '.'). Equivalent to the CLI's own rule: any "*.jsonl" in the sessions tree is a session transcript.

parse_line_for: see parser_strategy above.

Changes to watcher.rs / main.rs:
  - NONE required for the core adapter. The log is append-only, line-delimited UTF-8 JSON, exactly what LogTailer expects; depth is 2 (sessions/<project>/<file>) < 5; project dirs start with '-' so the '.'-skip rule is fine; notify on the sessions root catches the new file and each append.
  - OPTIONAL (model): a one-shot read of the sibling <uuid>.settings.json when session_start is seen. It is rewritten in place, so it must NOT be tailed; read it fresh and ignore parse errors.
  - OPTIONAL: add a second SessionSource for ~/.factory/projects because the official hooks doc's transcript_path example shows ".factory/projects/.../session.jsonl" while the shipped SDK and CLI code both use ".factory/sessions/...". Cheapest fail-safe: make the second root conditional on the directory existing, or (simplest) watch ~/.factory recursively with the same filename rule.

Unit tests to add (privacy tests mandatory):
  1. factory_droid_session_start_reports_project_only: header with cwd "C:\\Users\\me\\Documents\\Discodex" and a private title/owner -> SessionMetadata{project:"Discodex", cwd:...}; assert the title/owner strings appear in no emitted event.
  2. factory_droid_tool_use_produces_safe_activity: assistant message with tool_use {name:"Read", input:{file_path:"C:\\...\\src\\tray.rs", content:"PRIVATE"}} -> TrackedToolStarted{label:"Reading project files", file:Some("tray.rs"), language:Some("Rust")}; and an Execute tool_use with input.command "cargo test --release" -> label "Running Rust tests" with no command text in the event.
  3. factory_droid_tool_result_closes_tracked_call: user message with tool_result{tool_use_id:"call_1", content:"PRIVATE_OUTPUT"} -> TrackedToolFinished{call_id:"call_1"}; a repeated (id,parentId) pair must not emit a second finish.
  4. factory_droid_turn_boundaries_and_timestamps: user text message -> TaskStarted with 2026-10-20T09:30:00Z == 1792492200000; agent_turn_outcome -> Completed.
  5. factory_droid_never_forwards_private_text: feed a session containing prompt text, assistant prose, tool arguments and tool output; serialize every ParsedEvent and assert none of the private substrings occur (mandatory privacy test).
  6. provider-level: is_session_log(FactoryDroid, "0f7d....jsonl") == true; "0f7d....settings.json" == false; "0f7d....jsonl.events.lock" == false; session_sources() contains the ~/.factory/sessions root.

risks: Documented-vs-implemented path conflict: the official hooks doc shows transcript_path under '.factory/projects/.../session.jsonl', while the shipped SDK and the 0.245.0 binary both use '.factory/sessions/<sanitized-cwd>/<uuid>.jsonl'. Fail safe: watch ~/.factory recursively with the '*.jsonl' filename rule, or register both roots conditionally.

Header rewrite: the CLI can re-summarise the FIRST line (title update / shouldRewriteSessionSummary) and a fork writes a new file. The existing LogTailer tracks byte offsets, so an in-place header rewrite of different length can shift the cursor. Mitigate by making session_start handling idempotent and by re-reading from offset 0 when the file shrinks (already handled) — or re-derive the session_start from the settings sidecar.

Duplicate record ids: cancelled+retried tool calls reuse the message id (ctx issue #261), so dedupe on (id, seq) and treat parentId changes as new occurrences; otherwise a finish could be emitted twice or a tool left stuck open.

Field-name drift: the on-disk blocks use snake_case (tool_use_id, is_error) while the live protocol uses camelCase (toolUseId, isError); the header carries version:2. Accept both casings and ignore unknown record types.

Tool-name mismatch: classify_tool() will NOT match 'applypatch' (it tests for 'apply_patch') and will not map 'create' -> 'Editing files'; a Droid-specific name map is mandatory or the Discord label degrades to 'Using development tools'.

Model is not in the JSONL: publishing it requires reading the rewritten sidecar <uuid>.settings.json, which is not tailable; if that read fails, fall back to no model label (never fail the whole adapter).
Side-question (/btw) sessions live in a 'btw' subdir of the same root and will be reported as separate sessions; decide whether to skip that dir.

Multi-agent missions spawn child sessions with their own files (parent/callingSessionId) and a 'decompSessionType' of 'worker'; each child file is a separate Discodex session key, so the sub-agent label needs an explicit mapping (Task/SpawnAgent tool -> AgentDetected).

Windows path length: the sanitized project dir duplicates the full cwd, so deep paths can exceed MAX_PATH — the LogTailer must open with the \\?\ prefix (Discodex's normalize_path already strips it for matching).

The Factory desktop app and cloud sync (cloudSessionSync) are separate surfaces: cloud-only sessions would not appear locally, so a Droid session started on another machine is invisible to Discodex (expected, and compliant with the privacy rules).
confidence: High on the storage contract (path layout, JSONL format, append-only semantics, record schema and field names): all three independent sources agree — Factory's own shipped SDK code, the official 0.245.0 CLI binary, and two independent third-party readers. Medium on the model id (lives in a rewritten sidecar, not in the log) and on the exact tool_result reason enum values. Low/unverified on the '.factory/projects' path variant seen only in the hooks doc and on Droid window-title strings.
summary: Factory Droid is a viable Discodex adapter. The droid CLI stores every session locally as plain, append-only, newline-delimited JSON under %USERPROFILE%\.factory\sessions\ (per-project subdir named from the sanitized cwd, file = <uuid>.jsonl, plus a rewritten <uuid>.settings.json sidecar). Records are exactly what a Codex/DSH-style adapter needs: a session_start header carrying cwd (project) and version, then message records with id/parentId/seq/timestamp and Anthropic-style content blocks (tool_use with id/name/input -> file_path|command, tool_result with tool_use_id/is_error, thinking), plus agent_turn_outcome turn boundaries and todo_state/compaction_state markers. The file is appended live with fs.appendFileSync under a .events.lock, so the existing LogTailer works unchanged and no watcher/main.rs surgery is required. Only the model id lives outside the log (in the sibling .settings.json sidecar), and the official hooks doc's '.factory/projects/...' path example disagrees with the shipped code, so a defensive second root is recommended. Tool names must be mapped before classify_tool() (ApplyPatch -> apply_patch, Create -> write) or labels degrade. No encryption, no SQLite, no proprietary DB, no auth token needed to read the logs.
